_comment: The three starter guardian pets. Sourced from the React v1 repo: src/modules/pets/petData.ts (PETS, petAttack, petHp, PET_HUNT_SPEED, PET_ATTACK_RANGE, PET_ATTACK_CD, BOND_STAGES, PET_PERKS, PET_PERK_DESC) and src/lib/aggression.ts (petMaxHp — per-species bond-scaled HP). bondRanks 0-4 mirror the five BOND_STAGES; the rank-0 row carries no perk. Per-species combat values (huntSpeed/attackRange/attackCd) and the bond-scaled maxHp curve are canonical from v1. attackDamage is petAttack(rank) = 9 + rank*5, same for all species. deploySlots: home posts ring The Heart at radius 11 (petPost() in petData.ts: angle = i/3 * 2PI + 0.5).

bondRanks.perkDescription: Attacks arc to a 2nd nearby enemy for half damage.
The hero regenerates mana faster while this pet is deployed.
The Heart takes 15% less damage while this pet defends.
Every 5th attack releases an Aether nova around the pet.
Attacks set enemies alight - a burn that lingers.
Burns the ground it fights on - nearby enemies smoulder.
On a kill, the pet bursts into flame, hitting nearby foes.

pets.name: Ice Wolf
pets._flatCoatNote: WO-1326, owner ruling 2026-09-02 verbatim: 'flat coat'. The authored wolf_color coat map reached the Windows and Android payloads and NOT the WebGL one, so one tree rendered two different wolves. flatCoat suppresses the base map on every target: the tint above is the whole albedo, the normal map still gives the fur its relief, and all three builds agree. Omitting the key = the authored-map look, unchanged, for every other species.

bondRanks.perkDescription: Sturdier hide - its cold presence slows enemies near it.
Enemies near the Heart are chilled while this pet defends.
Every few seconds, freezes the nearest enemy solid.
